summary.text: Nolan West is a Republican state representative from Minnesota House District 32A who has served in the Minnesota House since 2017 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a business owner and former House caucus staffer.

paragraphs.text: Nolan West lives in Blaine, Minnesota, and earned a B.A. in history from the University of Minnesota in 2013.

His career experience includes owning Best in the West Media and working as a videographer, a committee legislative assistant with the Minnesota GOP House Caucus, and a major sales associate with Costco Wholesale.
Ballotpedia lists West's tenure in the Minnesota House as beginning in 2017, and his current term ends on January 12, 2027.

In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Commerce Finance and Policy, Children and Families Finance and Policy, and Ways and Means committees, and he co-chairs the Children and Families Finance and Policy committee.
